- When sentiment is strongly positive (≥ 0.8) in recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast by 1–3% for next 3–5 days.  
- When sentiment is strongly negative (≤ -0.8), model underestimates; adjust upward by 1–3% for next 3–5 days.  
- Model consistently overreacts to short-term spikes in sentiment; cap forecast peak at 2–3% above immediate prior high.  
- If 3+ consecutive days of high sentiment, model often overshoots; apply mean reversion correction: subtract 0.5–1.5% per day until sentiment stabilizes.  
- Forecast horizon 30d: model tends to underestimate late-period price action (last 7–10 days); add 0.5–1.5% to final 5–7 days if sentiment remains positive.  
- If sentiment history shows alternating highs/lows, model often misaligns with trend direction; favor sentiment-weighted moving average over raw forecast.
